title: Diagnose and fix deployment error

requirements.text: Investigate the deployment error that occurred during the most recent deployment attempt and identify the root cause by examining deployment logs, build output, and canister configuration

quotes: what error i got  can u fix it

acceptanceCriteria: The specific deployment error message and stack trace are identified
The root cause of the deployment failure is determined (e.g., Motoko compilation error, canister memory limit, network issue, configuration problem)
A clear diagnosis is provided explaining why the deployment failed

requirements.text: Fix the identified deployment error by applying the appropriate solution based on the root cause (e.g., correcting syntax errors, fixing type mismatches, adjusting canister settings, resolving dependency issues)
acceptanceCriteria: The code changes or configuration adjustments that caused the deployment error are corrected
The backend compiles successfully without errors
The frontend builds successfully without errors
The application can be deployed to the Internet Computer network without errors

requirements.text: Verify that the canister can be successfully deployed and that all existing functionality continues to work correctly after the fix is applied
acceptanceCriteria: The deployment completes successfully without errors
The canister is accessible and responsive after deployment
All existing features (user authentication, harvest listings, commitments, transport offers, buyer demands, crop diagnosis) remain functional
No regressions are introduced by the deployment fix

constraints: Do not modify the core business logic or data structures unless they are the direct cause of the deployment error
Preserve all existing user data and state during the fix
Maintain backward compatibility with existing frontend queries and mutations
nonGoals: Performance optimizations unrelated to the deployment issue
